name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
June 23, 2009
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Sarah Jimenez, Member of St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring June 24, 2009, "Tom Fleming Day" in the City of Vista.
P2.
Proclamation declaring June 25, 2009, "Judge K. Michael Kirkman Day" in the City of Vista.
P3.
Presentation of Certificates of Appointment to incoming Commission, Committee, and Board Members.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Amendment to the Fiscal Year 2009/10 Capital Improvement Program (CIP) Budget (CC)
C4.
Agreement for Landscape Plan Review Services (CC)
C5.
Energy Efficiency and Conservation Block Grant Application (CC)
C6.
Thibodo Road Curb and Landscaping Improvement Project (CIP No. 8151) (CC)
C7.
Traffic Signal Maintenance Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with San Marcos (CC)
C8.
Agua Hedionda Lagoon Watershed Cost-Share Agreement and TMDL Development (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving a cost-share agreement between the responsible parties of the Agua Hedionda Lagoon Watershed, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the agreement; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving an agreement with Larry Walker Associates to develop the TMDL program for the Agua Hedionda Lagoon Watershed and authorizing the Mayor to execute the agreement.
C9.
Adoption of the Fiscal Year 2009/10 Appropriations Limit (CC)
C10.
Amendment to Inland Rail Trail Project Agreement (CC)
C11.
Sewer System Management Plan (CC/BSD)
C12.
Authorizing the Execution of Certain Documents by the City Manager and the City Attorney (CC/CDC/BSD)
1.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Authorizing the Execution of Certain Documents by the City Manager and the City Attorney";
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- , confirming the procedures established by City Council Ordinance 2009- , are applicable to the Community Development Commission; and
3.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2009- , confirming the procedures established by City Council Ordinance 2009- , are applicable to the Buena Sanitation District.
C13.
Proposed State Take-Away of Local Highway User Tax/Gas Tax Revenues and Redevelopment Funds (CC)
C14.
Amendment to Employment Agreement with the City Manager (CC)
C15.
VCEA Labor Relations Agreement and Management and Confidential Employee Compensation Plan Amendments (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving a Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Vista and the Vista City Employees Association;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , amending the Management and Confidential Employee Compensation Plan. ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
City of Vista Emergency Operations Plan (CC)
D2.
Fiscal Year 2009-2010 Operating Budget (CC/BSD/CDC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving the Operating Budget;
2.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2009- , approving the Operating Budget;
3.
Adopt Community Development Commission No. 2009- , approving the Operating Budget;
4.
Adopt Community Development Commission No. 2009- , making certain findings regarding the use of Low and Moderate Income Housing funds for administrative purposes; and
5.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , amending the Citywide Classification and Compensation Index.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Collection of Delinquent 2008 Weed Abatement Charges (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to provide an opportunity for each owner of land or other interested person whose parcel is affected by the Report of Proceedings and an Account of Costs Incurred to present a written or oral protest or objection to such report and account, close the public hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving and confirming a report and account for abatement of weeds, shrubs, dead trees, and waste matter for Fiscal Year 2008/2009.
PH2.
Levy of Delinquent Mandatory Trash Charges for Fiscal Year 2008/09 (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony, close the public hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving liens on assessor's parcels within the City of Vista to be collected with the general property taxes on the Fiscal Year 2009/10 property tax roll for delinquent refuse collection service fees and collection charges.
PH3.
Collection of Delinquent Sewer Service Charges (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , memorializing the sewer service charges for Fiscal Year 2009/10 in accordance with City Ordinance No. 2008-4, and approving liens on assessor's parcels within the City of Vista to be collected with the general property taxes on the Fiscal Year 2009/10 tax roll for unpaid sewer service charges; and
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2009- , memorializing the sewer service charges for Fiscal Year 2009/10 in accordance with Buena Sanitation District Ordinance No. 2008-1, and approving liens on assessor's parcels within the District to be collected with the general property taxes on the Fiscal Year 2009/10 tax roll for unpaid sewer service charges.
PH4.
California Department of Transportation Vehicle Grant Program (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive public testimony regarding whether any local nonprofit service providers are readily available to provide services in lieu of the Out and About Vista Senior Transportation Program, and close the public hearing;
2.
In the absence of such providers, direct the City Manager to sign the "Public Agency Certification of No Readily Available Service Providers" and forward the document to the California Department of Transportation as part of its Section 5310 funding application; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , authorizing the submission of an application for grant funds from the California Department of Transportation Section 5310 Vehicle Program, and authorizing the City Manager to sign the application on behalf of the City.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
